phone.title: Rosdomofon
phone.description:
Enter the Russian phone number registered in Rosdomofon.

Format: {note}

sms.title: Phone confirmation
sms.description: Enter the SMS code sent to {phone}.

token.title: Sign in with a refresh_token
token.description: Enter a refresh_token obtained from the Rosdomofon mobile app. Use this method if your provider disabled SMS confirmation.

callback.title: Sign in by phone call
callback.description: Enter your registered Rosdomofon phone number. The next page shows the number to call and a live countdown.

callback_wait.title: Verify your phone
callback_wait.description: Open the verification page and call **{number}** from your registered phone. You have {seconds} seconds. The page shows a live countdown and checks verification automatically.

callback_retry.title: Try again
callback_retry.description: Verification expired or failed. Submit to return to the phone form.

error.sms_failed: Failed to send SMS. Please check the phone number and try again.
error.invalid_code: Invalid SMS code. Please try again.
error.invalid_refresh_token: Failed to exchange the refresh_token. Check that it was entered correctly and has not expired.
error.rate_limited: Too many requests. Please wait before retrying.
error.callback_unavailable: Phone-call login is unavailable for this number. Choose another method.
error.invalid_challenge: The service did not return a valid verification number.
error.not_confirmed: The phone call has not been verified yet.

generate_share_link.name: Generate guest link
generate_share_link.description: Generates a temporary link for a guest to open a lock.

entity_id.name: Lock
entity_id.description: Entity ID of the Rosdomofon lock.

ttl_hours.name: Validity period (hours)
ttl_hours.description: How many hours the link will be active (default 12).
